sources.snippet: Overview MiniCPM-o-4_5-gguf is a 9-billion-parameter multimodal language model built by openbmb that combines vision, speech, and text understanding in a single end-to-end architecture. The model integrates SigLip2 for vision, Whisper-medium for speech recognition, CosyVoice2 for speech synthesis, and Qwen3-8B as the language foundation. sources.snippet: MiniCPM-o 4.5: ⭐️⭐️⭐️ The latest and most capable model in the MiniCPM-o series. With a total of 9B parameters, this end-to-end model approaches Gemini 2.5 Flash in vision, speech, and full-duplex multimodal live streaming, making it one of the most versatile and performant models in the open-source community.
